parts.text: 子模块远程已经是合并提交 `d1acb5e147`（含我的移植 + 远程修复），父仓冲突的正确解法就是把 gitlink 指向它。开始处理。

tool_input.command: $main="D:\repository\门户"; $sub="$main\zhi2-web-admin"; $sha="d1acb5e1470081f3f560074b6fe0ea3a1c6537c8"; Write-Output "=== 前置校验 ==="; Write-Output "sub HEAD      : $(git -C $sub rev-parse HEAD)"; Write-Output "sub 工作区    : $(if((git -C $sub status --porcelain) -eq $null){'clean'}else{'dirty'})"; Write-Output "sub 远程      : $(git -C $sub ls-remote origin refs/heads/develop/v2.6.2-portal | ForEach-Object { $_.Split()[0] })"; Write-Output "=== 用 gitlink 直写解决冲突（保留双方工作） ==="; git -C $main update-index --cacheinfo 160000,$sha,zhi2-web-admin; Write-Output "EXIT=$LASTEXITCODE"; Write-Output "=== 校验 unmerged 清空 ==="; $u=git -C $main ls-files -u; if($u){ Write-Output $u } else { Write-Output "无 unmerged 项" }; Write-Output "=== gitlink 落点 ==="; git -C $main ls-files -s zhi2-web-admin; Write-Output "=== 暂存区差异 ==="; git -C $main diff --cached --stat
tool_input.description: Resolve submodule gitlink conflict to merged SHA

parts.text: 合并被主仓里重复的未暂存改动挡住（内容与 worktree 提交相同）。先核对一致，再还原工作区并做 FF 合并。

tool_input.command: $main="D:\repository\门户"; $f="docs/market-monitor-alignment.md"; Write-Output "=== 一致性核对 ==="; $h1=git -C $main hash-object $f; $h2=git -C $main rev-parse "align/mm-cleanup-final:$f"; Write-Output "main工作区 blob : $h1"; Write-Output "worktree提交 blob: $h2"; Write-Output "identical       : $($h1 -eq $h2)"; Write-Output "脚本在提交中删除: $(if((git -C $main ls-tree -r --name-only align/mm-cleanup-final -- scripts/build-market-monitor-standalone.mjs) -eq $null){'yes'}else{'no'})"; Write-Output "脚本在工作区    : $(Test-Path "$main\scripts\build-market-monitor-standalone.mjs")"; if($h1 -ne $h2){ throw "内容不一致，中止" }; Write-Output "=== 还原主仓工作区（改动已保存在 worktree 提交 7247576） ==="; git -C $main restore -- $f scripts/build-market-monitor-standalone.mjs; Write-Output "RESTORE_EXIT=$LASTEXITCODE"; Write-Output "=== FF 合并 ==="; git -C $main merge --ff-only align/mm-cleanup-final 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 5; Write-Output "MERGE_EXIT=$LASTEXITCODE"; Write-Output "=== 删除已合并分支 ==="; git -C $main branch -d align/mm-cleanup-final 2>&1; Write-Output "=== status ==="; git -C $main status --short
